title: Maize Prices: A New High Coming? 🌽 | Bullish vs Bearish Factors | Maize Market Outlook
description: Maize prices are at an interesting turning point. 🌽  Lower Kharif sowing and a sharp rise in exports are providing support to maize prices, while higher summer production and arrivals are keeping supply comfortable.  In this Maize Market Outlook, we look at the key factors that could influence prices ahead:  🔹 Kharif maize sowing 🔹 Maize exports from India 🔹 Summer maize production & yield 🔹 Market arrivals 🔹 MSP and domestic price trends 🔹 Rainfall and weather outlook 🔹 CME / international maize prices 🔹 Global maize production 🔹 Competing crops and feed demand  The key question: Can stronger exports and lower Kharif acreage outweigh the increase in available supply?  Watch till the end for our bullish vs bearish market view and the key factors to watch going forward.
